title: Casper and the Kitchen
author: Dominic Nystrom
blurb: Freya Almeida, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
